tool.name: Y-chromosome haplogroup
tool.description: from the reads of an exome, with Yleaf (YFull and ISOGG trees)
tool.command: ln -s '$bam' input.bam && ln -s '${bam.metadata.bam_index}' input.bam.bai && ## Yleaf accepts only .fa/.fasta/.fna names ln -s '$reference' reference.fa && export YLEAF_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 && python3 '$__tool_directory__/wes_yhaplo.py' --bam input.bam --reference reference.fa --sample '$bam.element_identifier' --threads \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-4} --min-y-ratio $min_y_ratio --min-reads $min_reads --prediction-quality $prediction_quality --json '$summary' --tsv '$lineage'

param.name: bam
param.label: Aligned reads (BAM)
param.help: Duplicate-marked reads of the sample, aligned to GRCh38 (Y or chrY).

param.name: reference
param.label: Reference genome (FASTA)
param.help: The genome the reads were aligned to. Yleaf only checks it for BAM input; without it Yleaf would download a genome.

param.name: min_y_ratio
param.label: Lowest Y/X ratio of mapped reads for a Y chromosome
param.help: About 0.01 in female exomes (reads mismapped to Y), 0.18-0.29 in male exomes (GIAB). 0 turns the check off.

param.name: prediction_quality
param.label: QC score for a high-confidence call (Yleaf -pq)

tool.help:
**What it does**
Assigns the Y-chromosome haplogroup (paternal lineage) of a male sample from its exome reads. Yleaf 4 piles up the reads at the SNPs of the YFull tree (v14) and walks the tree to the most derived haplogroup with support (at least 10 reads and 90 % of them for the derived base at a marker); it also gives the legacy ISOGG name.
The tool first checks for a Y chromosome: the ratio of reads mapped to Y and to X is about 0.01 in female exomes (reads mismapped to Y) and 0.18-0.29 in male exomes. Below 0.05 the sample is not typed.
**Exomes are less resolved than genomes**: the capture covers the Y genes and some off-target sequence, so the call is often an ancestor of the haplogroup a genome would give (a "paragroup" such as ``I1*``: none of the known subclades has enough reads). In 104 males of 1000 Genomes (tests/haplogroup_eval.py, truth from Poznik et al. 2016) no call was on a wrong branch; 98 reached the correct major haplogroup (A-T) or below.
**Outputs**: a JSON summary (YFull haplogroup and markers, ISOGG name, Y/X read ratio, informative markers, Yleaf QC scores, confidence, lineage) and a table of the derived nodes from the root to the call. The clinical report shows them in its ancestry/lineage subsection.
